product_family: Sophos is an enterprise cybersecurity vendor (endpoint, firewall, email, MDR/XDR) whose AI capabilities (50+ deep learning and GenAI models, Sophos AI Assistant, AI Search in XDR, NLP-based email/phishing detection) are embedded across its product line rather than sold as a standalone 'Sophos AI' product. Notable sub-products: Sophos Central (management platform), Sophos Endpoint, Sophos Email, Sophos XDR/Taegis MDR, Sophos Firewall, Sophos Cloud Optix.

certifications.name: SOC 2 Type II
certifications.proof_quote: Sophos Central has achieved SOC2 Type II certification and PCI DSS v3.2 attestation to demonstrate its strong security practices, policies and internal controls environment.

certifications.name: ISO 27001:2022
certifications.proof_quote: Demonstrates integration of security, privacy, and ongoing improvement into our daily operations. / Sophos achieves inaugural ISO 27001:2022 certification.

certifications.name: ISO 27017:2015 (cloud security controls)
certifications.proof_quote: Establishes information security controls that are specific to public cloud environments.

certifications.name: ISO 27018:2019 (cloud PII protection)
certifications.proof_quote: Establishes information security controls for protecting personally identifiable information (PII) data in public cloud environments.

certifications.name: ISO 27701 (privacy information management)
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence found on the Sophos Trust Center certifications page listing ISO 27701 alongside ISO 27001/27017/27018.

certifications.name: CSA STAR
certifications.proof_quote: Sophos is listed as a Trusted Cloud Provider with the Cloud Security Alliance (CSA) and has attained CSA STAR Level 1 status.

certifications.name: PCI DSS
certifications.proof_quote: Protects credit card data by ensuring secure storage, transmission, and handling of payment info. (listed as an attained compliance framework; corroborated: 'Sophos Central has achieved ... PCI DSS v3.2 attestation')

certifications.name: HIPAA
certifications.proof_quote: HIPAA is listed on the Trust Center as a compliance framework Sophos publishes guidance for ('Protects the privacy and security of medical records and health information in the U.S. healthcare industry'), but this is regulatory guidance/solution content, not a formal third-party HIPAA certification (no such certification scheme exists). Older third-party sources reference a '2020 SOC2 Type 1 and HIPAA Type 1 attestation' for specific products (Central, Cloud Optix, SophosLabs, MTR) that is stale and not corroborated on the current Trust Center. Customers requiring a BAA should request one directly from Sophos.

certifications.name: TX-RAMP
certifications.proof_quote: Products certified under the Texas Risk and Authorization Management Program (TX-RAMP) demonstrate compliance with rigorous security standards.

certifications.name: FedRAMP
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence of FedRAMP authorization found on the Sophos Trust Center certifications page; not mentioned alongside the listed frameworks (SOC 2, ISO, CSA STAR, PCI DSS, TX-RAMP, HITRUST, C5, CMMC, etc.).

certifications.name: ISO/IEC 42001 (AI management system)
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence found. Sophos publishes an 'AI Principles in Cybersecurity' governance statement but does not claim ISO/IEC 42001 certification on its Trust Center or AI principles page.

certifications.name: HITRUST CSF
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence of a held HITRUST CSF certification or attestation. The Sophos Trust Center lists HITRUST CSF only among the frameworks it publishes a downloadable 'Compliance guide (PDF)' / compliance card for (the same guidance-only treatment as HIPAA), not as an attained attestation with a certificate or a report available on request. Graded held=false to avoid over-claiming guidance content as a certification.

certifications.name: C5 (Germany, BSI)
certifications.proof_quote: The Sophos Trust Center lists BSI C5 (Cloud Computing Compliance Criteria Catalogue) with an attestation report available via a 'Request access to report' link, the same report-on-request mechanism used for its held SOC 2 and PCI DSS attestations, and distinct from the guidance-only 'Compliance guide' cards offered for HIPAA and HITRUST CSF. The report contents were not independently reviewed in this session.

privacy.ai_training_note: Sophos's AI Principles page states data handling for AI training is governed by 'clear usage policies and global privacy standards, including for AI training' and commits to GDPR/CCPA/EU AI Act compliance. Sophos Central AI-feature documentation states third-party LLM providers used by Sophos ('Azure OpenAI or Amazon Bedrock') do not train on customer inputs/outputs: 'Azure OpenAI or Amazon Bedrock won't use any inputs or outputs from our AI features to train models, or to improve their services.' No explicit customer-facing opt-out toggle for AI features was found in the reviewed documentation; Sophos states it restricts what data is sent to these third-party LLMs and scopes interactions to Sophos-product/security topics.
privacy.data_region: Sophos DPA states certain products let customers choose the hosting region for controller personal data, with international transfers covered by incorporated EU Standard Contractual Clauses (SCCs).

security.name: Third-party AI model data handling
security.value: Sophos restricts data sent to third-party LLMs (Azure OpenAI, Amazon Bedrock) to Sophos-product/security-related topics; provider contractually excluded from training on customer inputs/outputs per Sophos documentation.

security.name: Data transfer safeguards
security.value: Standard Contractual Clauses incorporated by reference into the Sophos DPA for restricted international data transfers.

security.name: Vulnerability disclosure / bug bounty
security.value: Public Bug Bounty program running since 2018; Sophos states the program has helped uncover over 1,200 vulnerabilities with nearly $500,000 paid in rewards.

security.name: Security governance
security.value: Trust Center references a secure development lifecycle, responsible disclosure program, incident response procedures, and CISO playbooks.

products.name: Sophos Central
products.data_scope: Endpoint telemetry, configuration, and admin data across the customer's Sophos estate
products.notes: In-scope for SOC 2 Type II and PCI DSS v3.2 attestation per vendor's own compliance page.

products.name: Sophos Endpoint
products.data_scope: Endpoint file/process telemetry analyzed on-device and in the cloud by deep-learning detection models
products.notes: Core deep-learning threat detection; part of the broader AI-native platform claims.

products.name: Sophos XDR / Taegis MDR
products.category: Extended detection and response / managed detection & response
products.data_scope: Cross-product telemetry (endpoint, network, email, cloud) plus analyst-facing GenAI assistant (AI Search) over that telemetry
products.notes: TX-RAMP certified per vendor Trust Center; GenAI 'AI Search' feature added per partner announcements (Nov 2024).

products.name: Sophos AI Assistant
products.category: GenAI assistant embedded in the security console
products.data_scope: Customer security-operations queries and relevant telemetry routed to third-party LLM providers under scoped restrictions
products.notes: Governed by Sophos's published AI Principles page; provider (Azure OpenAI/Amazon Bedrock) contractually excluded from training on inputs/outputs per Sophos docs.

products.name: Sophos Email
products.data_scope: Email content/metadata analyzed via deep-learning NLP for impersonation/phishing detection
products.notes: No separate cert scope statement found; assumed covered under organization-wide ISO 27001/SOC 2 posture, not independently confirmed.

compare.pricing_model: Enterprise/subscription licensing sold per-seat or per-device through channel partners and direct sales; not self-serve pricing.
compare.data_residency: Customer-selectable hosting region for controller personal data on certain products; SCCs used for restricted transfers.

flags: 'Sophos AI' is not a discrete standalone product on the vendor's site; it is a marketing umbrella for AI/GenAI features distributed across the full Sophos product line (Endpoint, Email, XDR, AI Assistant). Listing should be careful not to imply a single 'Sophos AI' SKU with its own independent security scope.

HIPAA is listed on the Sophos Trust Center compliance-guides page but is not a formal third-party certification; an older secondary source references a stale 2020 'HIPAA Type 1 attestation' for specific products that could not be corroborated on the current Trust Center — graded held=false to avoid over-claiming.

HITRUST CSF was corrected from held=true to held=false on QA re-check: the Trust Center offers only a downloadable HITRUST 'Compliance guide (PDF)' card (identical guidance-only treatment to HIPAA), with no certificate or attestation report on file — being listed among compliance-guide frameworks is not evidence of a held certification. C5 (BSI) is retained as held because it is offered as an attestation report on request, the same mechanism as the held SOC 2 and PCI DSS attestations.

Could not confirm from primary sources exactly which SOC 2 Type II scope boundary (which products beyond Sophos Central) is covered; the attestation quote found is specific to Sophos Central / Cloud Optix rather than the whole company.
No customer-facing opt-out toggle for AI-feature data routing to third-party LLMs was found in public documentation; only a scoping/restriction policy was found.

ISO/IEC 42001 (AI management system) and CSA STAR for AI were not found as held certifications despite Sophos publishing an AI principles/governance page; treat AI governance claims as policy statements, not third-party-audited certifications.
